paragraphs: A Land Rover AJ150D engine rebuild starts from £2,000. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
priceFactors: Vehicle-specific ancillaries (Discovery Sport vs Range Rover Evoque)

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most AJ150D owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six AJ150D-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover AJ150D engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ150D is Jaguar Land Rover's 1.5-litre three-cylinder diesel engine, part of the Ingenium family, in production since 2018.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the AJ150D?
faqLeft.a: Discovery Sport (D150, L550, 2018–present) and Range Rover Evoque (D150, L551, 2019–present).

faqLeft.q: Does the AJ150D differ between Discovery Sport and Range Rover Evoque?
faqLeft.a: The base engine is the same, but vehicle-specific ancillaries differ by application. We confirm your exact model by registration/VIN before any work proceeds.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover AJ150D engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on AJ150D rebuilds across both Discovery Sport and Range Rover Evoque applications.

faqLeft.q: Can you rebuild an AJ150D from a Discovery Sport?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The Discovery Sport D150 is one of the applications we work on regularly.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ150D from a Range Rover Evoque?
faqRight.a: Yes. The Range Rover Evoque D150 is one of the applications we work on regularly.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover AJ150D engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ150D engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
